introduction.title: Ayurvedic Perspective on Joint Health
introduction.description: According to Ayurveda, joint problems often arise from an accumulation of toxins (Ama) and an aggravation of Vata dosha, which dries out the lubricating fluids in the joints. Our therapies aim to remove toxins, pacify Vata, and nourish the bone tissues (Asthi dhatu).

items.question: Can Ayurveda cure arthritis completely?
items.answer: Ayurveda focuses on managing the condition, reducing pain, halting progression, and improving the quality of life, rather than promising a 'magic cure'.

items.question: Are Ayurvedic oils effective for joint pain?
items.answer: Yes, medicated Ayurvedic oils are highly effective in reducing Vata, lowering inflammation, and improving lubrication in the joints.

items.question: How long does the treatment take?
items.answer: Joint issues are often chronic. Significant relief requires time, consistency with medications, and strict adherence to dietary guidelines.
